# Historical installation fixtures

These files are exact snapshots from `gravity-ui/skills-dev` releases 1.1.0 (`97850d1`) and
1.1.1 (`d00b7f4`). They are test input, not current execution instructions. Installer tests use
these partial installations to verify recognition of both legacy generations, removal of obsolete
managed files, preservation of local changes, and migration to a distinct scenario identity.
The historical `EVAL.md` and `prices.json` are not part of the portable bundle.
